technical_research.technical_law: Integral Ampere circuital law in magnetostatics: ∮_C H·dl = I_enclosed. For time-varying E, Maxwell adds displacement current.

proof_by_option.A: Correct for the algebraic oriented enclosed conduction currents when magnetostatic and H is the field used; the question omits this qualifier.

source_original.question: Două sisteme de fazori trifazaţi oarecare, care au vârfuri comune şi origini diferite care se descompun în componente simetrice:

technical_research.object_and_assumption: Two arbitrary 3-phasor triples have common tips, but each triple's three arrows have one common origin; difference of origins is one nonzero complex vector d added to all three phase arrows.
technical_research.formulas: For a=exp(j2π/3), 1+a+a²=0. V0=(Va+Vb+Vc)/3; V1=(Va+aVb+a²Vc)/3; V2=(Va+a²Vb+aVc)/3. After common origin shift d: Vx' = Vx − d for x=a,b,c; V0'=V0−d; V1'=V1; V2'=V2.

reproducible_numeric_example.python_numeric_result: CHECKED (complex arithmetic), not an official exam verification

proof_by_option.A: «au numai aceleaşi componente directe» is FALSE under common-shift model because negative sequence is equal too; 'numai' wrongly claims exclusivity.
proof_by_option.B: «au aceleaşi componente inverse» is TRUE because the common shift cancels under Fortescue negative sequence.
proof_by_option.C: «au aceleaşi componente homopolare» is FALSE for different origins: zero sequence changes by −d.
